description: agroclimatico is an R package for calculating climate and hydrological indices from tidy observation tables. The Spanish-language README and package DESCRIPTION describe functions for seasonal statistics used in agriculture and water analysis. Users provide dated weather or flow measurements and select an index; outputs are derived series or summaries for the station, crop region and time period supplied. Geographic coverage follows input measurements. Its DESCRIPTION states GPL-3.0 licensing, and source data retain their own terms. A limitation is that an index calculated from sparse station data does not establish field-scale irrigation demand or extreme-event probability. The package can prepare drought and growing-season inputs for irrigation or food-system simulations. The related ERA5 catalogue record supplies gridded weather variables, not these calculated indices. No observation table or package archive was downloaded.
